survivors.description: Hash uses only the type, so it is consistent with equality but collides heavily across purls.
survivors.diff:
--- a/src/packageurl/__init__.py
+++ b/src/packageurl/__init__.py
@@ -285,3 +285,3 @@
     def __hash__(self):
-        return hash(self.to_string())
+        return hash(self.type)
survivors.words: src/packageurl/__init__.py:286: changing `        return hash(self.to_string())` to `        return hash(self.type)` made no test fail
